mil4.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, aṭṭhahi kāraṇehi buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, katamehi aṭṭhahi: vayapariṇāmena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, yasapariṇāmena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, paripucchāya buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, titthasaṃvāsena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, yoniso manasikārena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, sākacchāya buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, snehūpasevanavasena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati, patirūpadesavāsena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati. Bhavatīha:
mil4.4:2.1: Vayena yasa-pucchāhi titthavāsena yoniso sākacchā' snehasaṃsevā' patirūpavasena ca:
mil4.4:3.1: Etāni aṭṭha ṭhānāni buddhivisadakārakā, yesaṃ etāni sambhonti tesaṃ buddhi pabhijjatīti.
